children: Aerodrome Finance's public audit contest kicks off after the full release of its launch codebase, ahead of the protocol's planned Ethereum liquidity and exchange layer launch.

The release gives participants access to the implementation before launch and exposes the design for AERO revenue claims and buybacks. That makes the contest a public review point for the code supporting the planned exchange layer.

For investors, the available code provides a concrete basis for assessing the upcoming launch and its stated economic mechanisms. The effect on realized economics remains uncertain until the Ethereum liquidity and exchange layer goes live, so the audit materials do not by themselves establish operating results.
Aero's launch codebase is now fully released and the public audit contest officially kicks off tomorrow.
That means the launch of Ethereum's liquidity and exchange layer is fast approaching.
Everything that's coming — now readable in the code.

title: Aerodrome Finance: Public audit contest kicks off - 31 Aug 2026
